title: ClearGenerated Command
description: Delete Forsk-generated solids and opening markers by forsk:* tags. Optional untagged name-prefix fallback for pre-tag leftovers.

kinds.description: forsk:kind values to delete. Default wall, floor, roof, opening, opening_marker.

level.description: Optional forsk:level filter. Omit to match all levels.

dry_run.description: If true, return matching ids without deleting.

include_untagged_prefixes.description: If true, also delete untagged objects whose names start with name_prefixes.

name_prefixes.description: Name prefixes used only when include_untagged_prefixes is true. Default wall-, floor-, roof-, door-, window-.
